references.text: Describes the great trials and signs in Egypt that Israel saw with their eyes, including the plagues
The Lord performed signs and wonders in Egypt so that Israel would tell about them to future generations
The Lord promises to do wondrous deeds and signs never done before
Mentions trials, signs, wonders, and great, awe-inspiring deeds that God did in Egypt
The Lord performed great and terrible signs and wonders in Egypt before the eyes of Israel
Reminds of the great trials seen by the eyes, the signs and miracles in Egypt
Refers to the signs and deeds the Lord did in Egypt against Pharaoh
The psalm recounts the signs God performed in Egypt and the miracles on the fields of Zoan
Describes how the Lord set his signs in Egypt
Praises God for the signs and wonders he sent against Egypt and Pharaoh
Stephen's speech refers to the wonders and signs Moses did in Egypt
